confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Moroccan tourist-city pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. Bar and cocktail prices are less certain because alcohol is limited and priced variably in Fez, so beer, cocktail and wine anchors are estimated relative to each other. Accommodation anchors are broad bands that depend on riad versus hotel location and the summer season. FX is the RBA observation for 15 October 2026 as surfaced in search; a 16 October figure was also reported but its date labels were inconsistent, so it was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Morocco's inland medina tourism pricing, benchmarked against other Moroccan tourist cities such as Marrakech and Meknes, with the local price relationship used for cocktail and wine.
